params.command: $targets=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'localtunnel' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--port\s+7443' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--local-host\s+127\.0\.0\.1' }); $before=@($targets | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine); if($targets.Count -gt 0){ $ids=@($targets | ForEach-Object {[int]$_.ProcessId}); $roots=@($targets | Where-Object { $ids -notcontains [int]$_.ParentProcessId }); if($roots.Count -eq 0){$roots=$targets}; foreach($p in $roots){ & taskkill.exe /PID ([string]$p.ProcessId) /T /F | Out-Null } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $remaining=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'localtunnel' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--port\s+7443' -and $_.CommandLine -match '--local-host\s+127\.0\.0\.1' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine); $listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 7331,7443 } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,State); [ordered]@{before=$before; remaining=$remaining; listeners=$listeners} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7; if($remaining.Count -gt 0){exit 31}
